en-US.description: AI-powered office assistant that helps you complete office tasks faster and make decisions with more evidence, from spreadsheet analysis and file organization to information summarization.
en-US.longDescription: Office Xiaohuanxiong (part of the SenseTime Xiaohuanxiong family) is an AI-powered office assistant developed by SenseTime. It breaks vague goals or complex tasks into executable steps and produces high-quality deliverables; generates professionally structured presentations from a single sentence, with conversational editing and online editing of images, copy, and charts; automatically cleans, analyzes, and charts uploaded data, predicts trends, and generates analysis reports in one click; and turns uploaded documents and materials into a personal AI knowledge base that can be queried directly with @, helping with information lookup, email writing, poster creation, and copywriting.

zh-CN.author: 上海禹幻科技有限公司
zh-CN.description: AI 智能办公助手，从表格分析、文件整理到信息归纳，帮你更快完成办公任务，让决策更有依据。
zh-CN.longDescription: 办公小浣熊（商汤小浣熊家族）是商汤科技推出的 AI 智能办公助手。它能把模糊目标或复杂任务拆解成可执行的步骤，生成高质量的交付成果；一句话即可生成结构完整的专业 PPT，支持对话式修改以及图片、文案、图表的在线编辑；上传数据后自动完成清洗、分析、出图表与趋势预测，一键生成分析报告；上传文档和资料即可构建专属 AI 知识库，通过 @ 直接提问，完成信息查找、邮件撰写、海报制作和文案编写等任务。
zh-CN.name: 办公小浣熊
